macguffins.name: Axis Shard
macguffins.summary: A compass fragment that points toward events erased from history.

macguffins.name: Memory Seed
macguffins.summary: A crystallized memory capable of restoring one overwritten world.

macguffins.name: Echo Crown
macguffins.summary: A tournament seal that converts witnessed techniques into temporal fuel.

macguffins.name: Name of Dawn
macguffins.summary: The true name of the first repaired timeline, encoded as living light.

macguffins.name: Borrowed Sun Engine
macguffins.summary: A miniature star assembled from surrendered victories.

macguffins.name: Tomorrow Key
macguffins.summary: A key that opens only prisons whose inmates have not been born yet.

macguffins.name: Tenfold Banner
macguffins.summary: A blank standard that becomes the symbol chosen by a coalition.

macguffins.name: Mask of the False Ending
macguffins.summary: A perfect conclusion designed to trap heroes who accept easy closure.

macguffins.name: Unwritten Quill
macguffins.summary: A tool that can add one law to reality but cannot erase a cost.

macguffins.name: Heart of the Horizon
macguffins.summary: The choice at the center of every surviving timeline.
